title: The 'Void Radio'—A Signal From Nothing That Controls Spacecraft
hook: A radio signal is coming from a region of empty space where nothing exists—and it's been hijacking satellite systems for decades.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of a signal from nothing controlling our tech taps into deep paranoia about hidden forces in the universe.

title: The Classified 'Solar Lens'—A Telescope That Sees Alien Cities
hook: In the 1990s, the U.S. planned a telescope that could zoom in on exoplanets so clearly it would see streetlights—then it was classified.
why_this_can_go_viral: The promise of seeing alien civilizations combined with government secrecy creates irresistible click-through.

title: The 'Extinction Wind'—A Solar Gust That Strips Atmospheres Instantly
hook: A stream of particles from the sun hit Mars in 2022 and peeled away its remaining atmosphere—Earth is next.
why_this_can_go_viral: A real event that nearly happened to Earth triggers existential fear and urgency.

title: The 'Dark Matter Mirror'—A Galaxy That Reflects Nothing Back
hook: Astronomers found a galaxy that emits no light, no heat, no radio waves—it's a perfect dark mirror hanging in the void.
why_this_can_go_viral: The concept of a starless galaxy challenges our understanding of reality and sparks curiosity.

title: The 'Fermi Paradox Trap'—Every Civilization Gets Locked on Its Planet
hook: A new theory suggests there's a physical barrier that traps intelligent life on its home world—Earth is already inside it.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea that we're permanently trapped creates a claustrophobic, mind-bending narrative.

title: The 'Asteroid That Spit Fire'—A Rock That Ignited the Sky in 2018
hook: A small asteroid entered Earth's atmosphere, exploded with the force of a nuke, and left a plasma scar visible from space.
why_this_can_go_viral: Dramatic footage and the 'near miss' angle make this an easy share.

title: The 'Stellar Vampire'—A Star That Sucks the Life Out of Its Twin
hook: A star in the constellation Perseus is literally draining the plasma from its companion, leaving a corpse of dead matter.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'vampire' metaphor makes it instantly relatable and terrifying.

title: The Classified 'Space Minefield'—Orbital Traps Left by the Cold War
hook: Both superpowers seeded low Earth orbit with hidden explosive satellites—some are still active and untracked.
why_this_can_go_viral: Hidden Cold War dangers that could still explode trigger fear of invisible threats.

title: The 'Exoplanet That Screams'—A World Where Sound Travels Through Rock
hook: On a lava-covered exoplanet, seismic waves resonate at frequencies that sound like a human scream when converted.
why_this_can_go_viral: Personification of a planet as a screaming entity is deeply eerie and shareable.

title: The 'Gamma Ray Flash' That Almost Killed Every Satellite—In 2004
hook: A gamma-ray burst from a distant galaxy hit Earth's magnetic field and fried satellite electronics worldwide—it missed the atmosphere by a hair.
why_this_can_go_viral: A real near-miss event with global consequences feels like a disaster movie.

title: The 'Fermi Paradox Library'—A Book of Dead Civilizations
hook: Scientists theorize that the universe is full of graveyards—planets where technological civilizations die and leave behind data archives.
why_this_can_go_viral: The haunting image of a cosmic library of dead worlds fuels philosophical dread.

title: The 'Dark Matter String' Tied to the Moon—A Cosmic Leash
hook: A thread of dark matter appears to connect the Moon to a point in deep space, as if it's being pulled by an invisible hand.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of the Moon being anchored by an invisible force is both mysterious and unsettling.

title: The 'Signal That Erased Itself'—A Message That Vanished Mid-Transmission
hook: In 2007, a powerful signal from outside the galaxy started, then reversed itself—as if the sender deleted it on purpose.
why_this_can_go_viral: The mystery of a signal that undoes itself raises questions about who—or what—is hiding.

title: The 'Rogue Star' That Flung Uranus on Its Side
hook: A star passed through the early solar system and knocked Uranus sideways—and it's coming back in 1.4 million years.
why_this_can_go_viral: The return of a star that once reshaped the solar system is a long-term existential threat.

title: The Classified 'Moon Base Gamma'—A Colony Built in the 1960s
hook: Declassified documents suggest the U.S. built a permanent base on the far side of the Moon during the Cold War—and it's still running.
why_this_can_go_viral: Conspiracy theories about a hidden Moon base have endless viral potential.

title: The 'Asteroid That Cried'—A Rock That Leaks Water Into Space
hook: An asteroid in the main belt is venting water vapor like tears—and it's on a trajectory that crosses Earth's orbit.
why_this_can_go_viral: The emotional anthropomorphism of a 'crying' rock makes it highly shareable.

title: The 'Extinction Repeat'—The Same Asteroid Almost Hit Twice
hook: An asteroid that created a major impact crater 35 million years ago returned on a near-identical trajectory in 2021.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea that history literally repeats itself in cosmic collisions is captivating.

title: The 'Fermi Paradox Vaccine'—A Signal That Immunizes Against Contact
hook: Some believe a 'galactic warning' signal exists that tells civilizations to stay quiet—Earth may have already received it.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea that we've been warned to stay silent is both sci-fi and terrifyingly plausible.

title: The 'Pulsar That Killed Its Own Planet'—A Star That Murdered Its World
hook: A pulsar in the Milky Way is spinning so fast it tore apart its own planet and now rains radiation on the debris.
why_this_can_go_viral: The metaphor of a star murdering its own planet is visceral and dark.

title: The Classified 'Van Allen Belts Weapon'—A Plan to Electrify Space
hook: In the 1960s, the Air Force considered detonating nuclear bombs in the Van Allen belts to create an electromagnetic shield—over the enemy.
why_this_can_go_viral: A plan to weaponize Earth's radiation belts is both brilliant and insane.

title: The 'Signal From the Void'—A Transmission That Contains Human DNA
hook: A signal from a dead region of space carried a sequence that matches 97% of human DNA—as if someone sent a blueprint.
why_this_can_go_viral: The implication that we were designed or cataloged by an alien intelligence is explosive.

title: The 'Rogue Black Hole' That Swallowed a Star—And Spit It Back Out
hook: A rogue black hole in 2019 consumed a star, but half the star's mass ejected at near light speed—a cosmic near-miss.
why_this_can_go_viral: The violent, unpredictable behavior of black holes is endlessly fascinating.

title: The 'Extinction Ice'—A Comet That Will Freeze the Earth's Oceans
hook: A dark comet made of frozen nitrogen is heading toward Earth on a 12,000-year cycle—and it's due in 2036.
why_this_can_go_viral: A specific date for a potential extinction event creates immediate urgency and shareability.

title: The 'Fermi Paradox Zoo'—We Are the Exhibit, Not the Visitors
hook: A growing number of scientists now believe Earth is a controlled preserve—and we're being watched like animals in a cage.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea that we're not explorers but exhibits destroys our sense of freedom and power.
